name: vice-sunset
description: A GTA VI-inspired look: purple-to-sunset sky, palm silhouettes, distant skyline, plum glass panels, neon-pink accents and a launch countdown above the composer.

showCountdown.title: Show countdown
showCountdown.description: Show the slim countdown row above the message box.

countdownLabel.title: Countdown label
countdownLabel.description: The neon-pink word at the start of the countdown row.

countdownTarget.title: Countdown target
countdownTarget.description: Target date and time, ISO 8601. Add an offset to pin a timezone, e.g. 2026-11-19T00:00:00-05:00. Without one it is read as UTC.

animate.title: Animated atmosphere
animate.description: Drifting haze, swaying palms and flickering windows. Off gives a still scene.
